title: Secretary Rubio’s Call with UAE National Security Advisor Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan
author: Office of the Spokesperson
summary:
Office of the Spokesperson

Secretary Rubio’s Call with UAE National Security Advisor Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan

Readout

August 18, 2026

The below is attributable to Principal Deputy Spokesperson Tommy Pigott:

Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke today with UAE National Security Advisor Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The two discussed a number of regional security issues, including Lebanon, as well as continued U.S.-UAE coordination to hold Iran and its terrorist proxies accountable for ongoing attacks. Secretary Rubio underscored the importance of freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz.
